interactions.conditions: worst-case single-contact 3.0A rating vs the project's +12V/1.2A, +5V/0.5A, -12V/0.8A rail budgets (pins 7-8, 5-6, 15-16) gives large nominal margin even ignoring the second parallel pin in each pair, but the rating is UNSOURCED at primary-manufacturer level and comes from a generic-position-count drawing; contact resistance and thermal rise under sustained rail current needs a bench check

the six-pin GND moat (pins 9-14) separating +12V (7-8) from -12V (15-16) and the misalignment-safe pin ordering are doc-level design statements, not Ref.Pin-baselined; the key/polarization-slot orientation of the physical footprint is separately not netlist-verifiable at all -- both need bench/visual confirmation before Board B layout is finalized
